title: morus alba subvar. colombassa
intro: Morus alba subvar. colombassa, commonly known as White Mulberry, is a deciduous tree native to China and is characterized by its white or pale yellow flowers and edible white or pale yellow fruits. The health benefits of Morus alba subvar. colombassa include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve blood sugar control, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may be attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Morus alba subvar. colombassa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthraquinones, which have been shown to contribute to its medicinal properties.
